intro: Mellow Mushroom is the Southeastern pizza chain famous for its stone-baked pizzas on a signature spring-water dough brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, served in colorful, psychedelic-themed dining rooms. The menu runs specialty pizzas like the Kosmic Karma and Holy Shiitake, plus hoagies, calzones, pretzel bites and big salads. Below is the full Mellow Mushroom menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Mellow Mushroom, a large specialty pizza runs about $26.99 to $29.99 (Mighty Meaty large $29.99), a large cheese is $16.99, and a build-your-own large starts at $16.99. Hoagies are $10.99 half or $15.99 whole, calzones about $10.99 to $15.99, and pretzel bites $9.99. The stone-baked specialty pizzas are the signatures. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Mellow Mushroom value: a large cheese ($16.99) or a build-your-own large ($16.99) is the cheapest way to feed a group, well below the loaded specialties. A half hoagie ($10.99) makes a cheaper single meal. The Mellow Rewards program drops occasional deals. Prices vary by location, and the big-city stores run higher.

faqs.q: How much is a large pizza at Mellow Mushroom?
faqs.a: A large specialty pizza runs about $26.99 to $29.99 (the Mighty Meaty is $29.99), a large cheese is $16.99, and a large pepperoni $19.99. A build-your-own large also starts at $16.99. Prices vary by location and can be higher in big-city stores.

faqs.q: What is Mellow Mushroom known for?
faqs.a: Mellow Mushroom is known for its stone-baked pizzas on a signature spring-water dough brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, its colorful psychedelic-themed restaurants, and specialty pies like the Kosmic Karma and Holy Shiitake. The pretzel bites are a cult-favorite starter.

faqs.q: Does Mellow Mushroom have vegan and gluten-free options?
faqs.a: Yes. Mellow Mushroom is known for accommodating diets, with vegan cheese and a vegan build-your-own pizza at the same price, gluten-free crust options, and plant-based items like the tempeh hoagie. Availability varies by location.
Mellow Mushroom does not prominently publish per-item calories, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Totals depend heavily on the pizza size, crust and toppings you choose.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Mellow Mushroom?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Kosmic Karma, the Holy Shiitake, the Mighty Meaty, the pretzel bites, and the steak and cheese hoagie.
